title: Total junk, but the box is cool.
text:
[[VIDEOID:fc3a54833c0aa32b2bc8bffa9aba323f]] Like many other reviewers mentioned, the products that come in the box are cheap junk and could easily be purchased from your local dollar store. The only thing my cat liked was the catnip toy and the cardboard box.

However, I will say it was worh the ten bucks to witness my cat try to defend his catnip pile (the dog had torn it open and scattered the leaves on the carpet) from my MalShi. Pretty much the most comical thing I've seen in at least a week (check out my posted video).

But honestly, not worth the discounted $10, and DEFINITELY not worth the normal subscription price of $20. Save yourself some hard earned cash and go grab some cheap catnip and a cardboard box at the dollar store.
label: negative
